# `gcp.regionnetworkendpointgroup`

A regional NEG that can support Serverless Products, proxying traffic to external backends and providing traffic to the PSC port mapping endpoints. When in use by a resource that can be updated, recreating a RegionNetworkEndpointGroup will give a `resourceInUseByAnotherResource` error because Terraform will attempt to delete the RegionNetworkEndpointGroup first, but an in-use RegionNetworkEndpointGroup can't be deleted in the API. Use `lifecycle.create_before_destroy` to reorder the plan and create the new resource first, allowing the deletion to go through successfully. This is only recommended when strictly necessary, as the `create_before_destroy` directive can be passed onto further dependencies, creating unexpected plans.
